campaign_id.description: The Bluecore campaign identifier. This identifier can be obtained from the Bluecore UI campaigns page.

template_attributes.description: A JSON formatted object containing data to be used in the Email template.

customer_attributes.description: A JSON formatted object containing data to add to or update for the customer record.

use_draft.description:
A flag indicating if the draft version of a campaign should be used.
Default: False.

product_ids.description:
This parameter is currently in development and is not available for general use at this time. This will be available in a future release.

List of product ids to be used as input products only if the campaign uses the co-recommendations product block.
